content.title: Multiple sidebar switches keep one-page state
content.intent: Prove repeated sidebar changes across primary, analytics, research, and system contexts keep the dashboard in the same single-page shell while the active item and workspace heading update in place.
content.technique_notes: Applied state / flow and negative reasoning to the source's forbidden routing promise across a multi-hop navigation sequence. Used representative section switching instead of all permutations because the outcome is the same single-page in-place update for each hop. Risk-gated covering strength was 2 because no money, auth, or data-loss factor applies; no covering array was needed for this single dominant sequence path.
